# Changelog

What changed in each plugin release, newest first. In an agent, ask for `beau-help new`.

## bstack 0.7.0 (2026-11-10)

- New `beau-help` skill lists every agent-kit skill and playbook, with how to call each one in your tool.
- `beau-help new` shows what changed since you last looked. In Claude Code it also appears once at session start after an update.
- Try: `beau-help verify`

## bstack 0.6.0 (2026-11-10)

- beau-mode restates your goal first and carries it into every subagent brief, PR and final reply. It stops when the evidence rules out the change you asked for.
- interrogate keeps only findings an adversary proves with a command it ran; the lead reruns each one.
- create-verification-skill counts an app as ready only when it works from an empty data directory, and never weakens a journey to make it pass.
- Multi-phase plans run one full swarm at the code-ready head and one verifier for rebases.
- reflect never edits a skill inside a plugin cache.

## principles 0.2.0 (2026-11-10)

- test-behavior-not-implementation, fix-root-causes, attack-the-premise and make-operations-idempotent now explain the idea instead of banning specific mechanisms.
- explain-the-number asks you to decide what result would change your mind before you measure.

## bstack 0.5.0 (2026-11-10)

- New create-formal-verification-skill and maintain-formal-verification-skill model-check or prove the code where bugs cost most (races, retries, state machines, parsers).
- Try: `model-check the retry logic in this queue`

## essentials 0.2.0 (2026-11-10)

- New sharpen skill makes a task deeper instead of bigger, then rewrites the prompt.
- Try: `/sharpen add caching to the API`

## bstack 0.4.0 (2026-11-09)

- New state-machines skill finds lifecycle logic spread across flags and makes it an explicit state machine. beau-mode routes lifecycle work to it.
- Try: `find the implicit state machines in this module`

## bstack 0.3.1 (2026-11-07)

- beau-mode treats a task as done only when every test and CI check passes. Flaky tests get measured, root-caused and fixed, never re-run.

## bstack 0.3.0 (2026-11-07)

- New Product phase playbook moves one product phase through Specced, Planned, Building, Gated and Done.
- New scaffold-product skill sets up a new product repo, or adopts an existing one, with a vision, decision log, phase specs and a verify skill.
- Try: `scaffold this repo for product work`

## bstack 0.2.1 (2026-11-07)

- Description fixes so the skills trigger on the phrases you actually type.

## cfo 0.1.0 (2026-10-31)

- New cfo plugin keeps a private ledger of AI and cloud spend, estimates runs before they start, and writes a weekly brief. It never pays, cancels or deletes anything.
- Try: `estimate what this run will cost`

## essentials 0.1.1 (2026-10-27)

- New grilling skill stress-tests a plan one round of questions at a time before you act on it.
- Try: `grill me on this migration plan`

## bstack 0.2.0 (2026-10-11)

- New skills for proof and understanding: create-verification-skill, maintain-verification-skill, why, teach, recall.
- New skills for design and parallel work: architect, arena, swarm, technical-writing.
- New Multi-phase plan playbook turns an agreed design into small, verifiable PRs.

## bstack 0.1.0 (2026-10-11)

- First release. beau-mode routes each task to a playbook, plus how, interrogate, verify-work, show-me-your-work, figure-it-out, reflect, correct and unslop, and the beau-agent subagent.

## principles 0.1.0 (2026-10-11)

- First release. Twenty-four named engineering principles in one skill, one file per principle.

## essentials 0.1.0 (2026-10-09)

- First release, with commit-message and handoff-notes.

## eng-leadership 0.1.0 (2026-10-09)

- First release, with design-review and interview-kit.

## research-tools 0.1.0 (2026-10-09)

- First release. library-docs looks up current library docs through Context7, with a fallback when the MCP server is missing.
